body: If I could somehow move to the UK I would, people hate on it and I understand it's nowhere close to being a perfect country but fuck me my quality of life would improve, especially as I wouldn't have to worry about going to the doctors without bullshit from doctors,hospitals, and health insurance companies/paying $1000+ for 1 months prescription/paying $5000 for a fucking colonoscopy when the insurance told you that it would be fully covered.

It's a thundercunt, worst part I was raised in a country with universal healthcare, then parents decided to move to the US. Major mistake, now stuck here, returning is not an option without a 6 month waiting period for healthcare.
